panels.title: Assumptions — the estimates below are only as good as these

panels.description: Static input to every estimate on this dashboard. Served from a gauge in /etc/n8n-exporter.env -- change it there and every tile below re-derives. No panel hardcodes these values. Words/min for prose-like output: file reads, web fetches, search results.
panels.title: Reading speed

panels.description: Static input to every estimate on this dashboard. Served from a gauge in /etc/n8n-exporter.env -- change it there and every tile below re-derives. No panel hardcodes these values. Words/min for command output (Bash/Grep/Glob) -- scanned for the failure line, not read. ~54% of all consumed characters, so this rate matters more than the reading one.
panels.title: Skim speed

panels.description: Static input to every estimate on this dashboard. Served from a gauge in /etc/n8n-exporter.env -- change it there and every tile below re-derives. No panel hardcodes these values. Words/min a human writes prose. Values vLLM completion tokens.
panels.title: Writing speed

panels.description: Static input to every estimate on this dashboard. Served from a gauge in /etc/n8n-exporter.env -- change it there and every tile below re-derives. No panel hardcodes these values. Lines of file content a human authors per hour, including design and review. This single number dominates the Claude Code value estimate.
panels.title: Authoring rate

panels.description: Static input to every estimate on this dashboard. Served from a gauge in /etc/n8n-exporter.env -- change it there and every tile below re-derives. No panel hardcodes these values. Words per LLM token. Applies to the vLLM side only, where work is measured in tokens.
panels.title: Words per token

panels.description: Static input to every estimate on this dashboard. Served from a gauge in /etc/n8n-exporter.env -- change it there and every tile below re-derives. No panel hardcodes these values. Characters per word, converting measured transcript characters into words.
panels.title: Chars per word

panels.description: Static input to every estimate on this dashboard. Served from a gauge in /etc/n8n-exporter.env -- change it there and every tile below re-derives. No panel hardcodes these values. Working hours per day, used to express the headline in days rather than hours.
panels.title: Hours per day

panels.description: Static input to every estimate on this dashboard. Served from a gauge in /etc/n8n-exporter.env -- change it there and every tile below re-derives. No panel hardcodes these values. Fully loaded hourly cost of the human whose time is being saved.
panels.title: Loaded labor rate
All-time total — vLLM judgment work + Claude Code build work

panels.description: ALL-TIME, both systems combined, ignoring the time picker. vLLM (hermes judges classifying text) valued via tokens->words->reading/writing time; Claude Code valued via lines authored plus output consumed. Different units of work, both converted to human-equivalent time, then summed. vLLM history begins 2026-08-03 (n8n retention); Claude Code begins 2026-07-09.

targets.expr: ((((sum(atlas_vllm_prompt_tokens_total{job="atlas-n8n"}) * scalar(atlas_productivity_words_per_token) / scalar(atlas_productivity_read_wpm) / 60) + (sum(atlas_vllm_completion_tokens_total{job="atlas-n8n"}) * scalar(atlas_productivity_words_per_token) / scalar(atlas_productivity_write_wpm) / 60)) + ((sum(claude_lines_produced{kind=~"written|added"}) / scalar(atlas_productivity_lines_per_hour)) + ((sum(claude_chars_consumed{mode="read"}) / scalar(atlas_productivity_chars_per_word) / scalar(atlas_productivity_read_wpm) / 60) + (sum(claude_chars_consumed{mode="skim"}) / scalar(atlas_productivity_chars_per_word) / scalar(atlas_productivity_skim_wpm) / 60)))) / scalar(atlas_productivity_hours_per_day))

targets.expr: ((((sum(atlas_vllm_prompt_tokens_total{job="atlas-n8n"}) * scalar(atlas_productivity_words_per_token) / scalar(atlas_productivity_read_wpm) / 60) + (sum(atlas_vllm_completion_tokens_total{job="atlas-n8n"}) * scalar(atlas_productivity_words_per_token) / scalar(atlas_productivity_write_wpm) / 60)) + ((sum(claude_lines_produced{kind=~"written|added"}) / scalar(atlas_productivity_lines_per_hour)) + ((sum(claude_chars_consumed{mode="read"}) / scalar(atlas_productivity_chars_per_word) / scalar(atlas_productivity_read_wpm) / 60) + (sum(claude_chars_consumed{mode="skim"}) / scalar(atlas_productivity_chars_per_word) / scalar(atlas_productivity_skim_wpm) / 60)))) * scalar(atlas_productivity_rate_usd_per_hour))

panels.title: Authoring hours (human-equiv)

panels.description: ALL-TIME. Human-equivalent time to CONSUME what Claude read. Read/WebFetch/WebSearch output is valued at atlas_productivity_read_wpm; Bash/Grep/Glob output at the faster atlas_productivity_skim_wpm, because command output is skimmed for the failure line rather than read word for word (it is ~54% of all consumed characters).

panels.description: ALL-TIME. Human-equivalent time to AUTHOR the lines Claude produced, at atlas_productivity_lines_per_hour. One assumption, against the vLLM tiles' three. Combined authoring + reading time at the loaded labor rate.
